th.th_shadows_viridian.name: Shadows of Viridian
ev_vi_line_of_leaving.b1: A column of Pokémon crosses the road in silence. Your Starter walks beside it for ten steps before it turns back.
ev_vi_line_of_leaving.b2: The line does not look at you. It does not need to.
ev_vi_line_of_leaving.c.walk_with_it: Walk beside the line for a while.
ev_vi_line_of_leaving.c.follow_tracks: Follow the tracks back to where it began.
ev_vi_line_of_leaving.c.note_it: Write it down and move on.
ev_vi_stake_and_string.b1: Survey stakes with Greenwall paint cross a nesting hill. A string runs from stake to stake into the trees.
ev_vi_stake_and_string.b2: Someone measured this hill very carefully, and kept it quiet.
ev_vi_pilars_clinic.b1: The Accord medic treats burned Pokémon in a barn. She asks for no allegiance, only clean water.
ev_vi_pilars_clinic.b2: She does not ask which side you are on. She does not say why.
ev_vi_pilars_clinic.c.keep_walking: Say you are only passing through.
ev_vi_the_other_pamphlet.b1: A Combine memo and an Accord leaflet use the same phrase, word for word.
ev_vi_the_other_pamphlet.b2: Someone is writing both sides, and enjoying it.
ev_vi_the_other_pamphlet.c.confront: Take them to the nearest ranger.
ev_vi_brook_at_dusk.b1: The site manager sits alone on a stump and asks what the forest is for.
ev_vi_brook_at_dusk.b2: He waits for an answer as if his job depended on it. He will remember it.
ev_vi_brook_at_dusk.c.not_for_anything: Say it is not for anything. It just is.
ev_vi_brook_at_dusk.c.for_everyone: Say it is for everyone who lives in it.
ev_vi_brook_at_dusk.c.for_the_town: Say it is for the town.
ev_vi_burn_that_isnt.b1: A controlled burn jumps its line. The fire is moving toward a stand of old trees.
ev_vi_burn_that_isnt.b2: Someone lit this on a windy day. That was not an accident.
ev_vi_burn_that_isnt.c.fight_fire: Fight the fire with the whole party.
ev_vi_burn_that_isnt.c.split_up: Split the party and do both.
ev_vi_hollis_map.b1: The old ranger's trail map has one trail missing. He will not say why.
ev_vi_hollis_map.b2: He folds the map along a crease that has been folded a thousand times.
ev_vi_verdelis_shadow.b1: For one screen, a shape larger than any Pokémon stands between the trees. Your Starter bows first.
ev_vi_verdelis_shadow.b2: The shape does not come closer. It has been watching longer than anyone has been counting.
ev_vi_grove_census.b1: The Grove Census begins in Halvard Row: a count of forest Pokémon the Combine wants to fail.
ev_vi_grove_census.b2: Every name on the roll is a Pokémon someone has to stand up for.
ev_vi_the_choice.b1: Strand's ledger is on one side of the table and Greaves's map on the other. The forest is on the third.
ev_vi_the_choice.b2: Whatever you decide, the trees will hear it.
ev_vi_the_choice.c.sabotage: Sabotage one and expose the other.
ev_vi_the_choice.c.sit_with_forest: Sit with the forest and wait.
end.end_vi_standing.name: The Forest Stands
end.end_vi_standing.scene: The forest stands still and every Pokémon looks up.
end.end_vi_restored.name: Restored
end.end_vi_restored.scene: New growth in the burned ring.
end.end_vi_scarred.name: Scarred
end.end_vi_scarred.scene: A half-green hill; the Starter lies in the ash.
end.end_vi_reckoning.name: A Hard Reckoning
end.end_vi_quiet_leaving.name: The Quiet Leaving
end.end_vi_quiet_leaving.scene: The line of leaving walks on; you follow it to the road.
tw.tw_both_hands.reveal: The Accord's fires and the Combine's clear-cuts provoke each other on purpose.
tw.tw_both_hands.motive: Strand wants the forest declared a hazard; Greaves wants a reason to burn grid lines.
tw.tw_both_hands.consequence: Pilar and Brook both become possible defectors.
tw.tw_both_hands.clue.clue_paint: Matching paint on stakes and on a barn door.
tw.tw_both_hands.clue.clue_courier: A shared courier carries both sides' letters.
tw.tw_both_hands.clue.clue_memo_date: A Combine memo is dated the same day as a fire.
tw.tw_both_hands.clue.clue_pilar_silence: Pilar goes quiet whenever the paint comes up.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.reveal: Hollis Wren signed the first Greenwall survey twenty years ago.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.motive: He wanted a ranger post for a failing town and did not read the map.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.consequence: Forgive, shame, or repair the trail together.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.clue.clue_missing_tr: One trail is missing from his map.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.clue.clue_stake_tag: His signature is on an old stake tag.
tw.tw_hollis_signed.clue.clue_hollis_ref: He will not set foot on Greenwall land.
th.th_shadows_viridian.journal.name: The Hush Ledger
th.th_shadows_viridian.journal.t1: {town} lost its {pokemon} this week. The forest was quiet by dusk. Marginalia drew the empty branch.
th.th_shadows_viridian.journal.t2: {character} says the paint is Combine. {rival} says it is Accord. The paint is both.
th.th_shadows_viridian.journal.t3: The forest let {starter} walk closer today.
th.th_rivals_promise.name: The Rival's Promise
ev_rp_dock_words.b1: Your Rival repeats the promise a second time, word for word, and flinches.
ev_rp_dock_words.b2: The promise is the same. The way they say it is not.
ev_rp_dock_words.c.ask_who: Ask who it was made to.
ev_rp_one_umbrella.b1: Rain forces a shared stop. Your Rival talks about everything except the promise.
ev_rp_one_umbrella.b2: Under one umbrella, nobody has to look at anybody.
ev_rp_one_umbrella.c.share_snack: Share a snack and stay out of it.
ev_rp_ledger_page.b1: A torn ferry log shows your Rival's name beside a cargo they never saw.
ev_rp_ledger_page.b2: Someone has been using their name. Someone who knows where they sleep.
ev_rp_unsent_letter.b1: You find a letter in your Rival's coat. It is addressed, stamped, and never sent.
ev_rp_unsent_letter.b2: The ink has been rubbed thin where a thumb kept checking it.
ev_rp_training_reps.b1: Your Rival drills one move for six hours at the training yard.
ev_rp_training_reps.b2: They are not getting better. They are getting quieter.
ev_rp_cup_draw.b1: The Harbor Cup bracket is drawn on a chalkboard. Your Rival's name sits in the other half, and they want it swapped.
ev_rp_cup_draw.b2: It is a small favor. It is also the first one they have ever asked for.
ev_rp_wrong_ferry.b1: Your Rival boards a ferry you know belongs to a smuggler.
ev_rp_wrong_ferry.b2: The gangplank is already coming up.
ev_rp_wrong_ferry.c.warn: Shout a warning from the dock.
ev_rp_lantern_toast.b1: After the Cup, a lantern is lit for the person the promise was for. You hold the match.
ev_rp_lantern_toast.b2: The flame takes a long time to catch. Then it does not need help.
ev_rp_lantern_toast.c.hand_it_over: Hand the match to your Rival.
ev_rp_ribbon.b1: A ribbon snagged on a dock rope matches the one your Rival's missing Ace wore.
ev_rp_ribbon.b2: The knot is a smuggler's knot.
ev_rp_the_choice.b1: The promise sits between you like a third person. Keep it, break it, or say a new one.
ev_rp_the_choice.b2: Whatever you say, your Rival will hear it as an answer.
ev_rp_the_choice.c.keep: Keep the promise as it was.
end.end_rp_kept_together.name: Kept Together
end.end_rp_kept_together.scene: Both stand on the dock; the lantern is lit.
end.end_rp_renegotiated.name: Renegotiated
end.end_rp_broken.name: Broken
end.end_rp_broken.scene: The Rival leaves on the first ferry; a lantern floats.
end.end_rp_cup_alone.name: The Cup, Alone
end.end_rp_cup_alone.scene: A trophy and an empty seat.
end.end_rp_unspoken.name: Unspoken
end.end_rp_unspoken.scene: The promise is never answered; you carry it.
tw.tw_promise_to_other.reveal: The promise was made to someone who does not want it kept.
tw.tw_promise_to_other.motive: Your Rival loved the person and could not hear the refusal.
tw.tw_promise_to_other.consequence: The promise is kept together, broken, or renegotiated.
tw.tw_promise_to_other.clue.clue_sentenc: A sentence in the promise changes meaning when said slowly.
tw.tw_promise_to_other.clue.clue_lantern: A lantern that was never lit.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.reveal: Your Rival's missing Pokémon is on Rusk's boat.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.motive: Rusk collects strong Pokémon as leverage.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.consequence: The Ace becomes a Journal memory, and a rescue Stop opens.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.clue.clue_ribbon: A ribbon tied in a smuggler's knot.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.clue.clue_cargo_log: A cargo log with the Rival's name on it.
tw.tw_ace_with_rusk.clue.clue_ace_cry: The Ace's cry from a hold.
th.th_rivals_promise.journal.name: The Promise Book
th.th_rivals_promise.journal.t1: {rival} made a promise and {player} was there to hear it.
th.th_rivals_promise.journal.t2: {rival} wins more when no one is watching. {player} noticed.
th.th_rivals_promise.journal.t3: On {stage}, {rival} stopped saying the promise out loud.
th.th_champions_legacy.name: A Champion's Legacy
ev_cl_gilt_pin.b1: A cracked laurel pin shows up on a referee. No one else notices it.
ev_cl_gilt_pin.b2: You notice it again two towns later, on someone else.
ev_cl_press_pit.b1: Reporters shout your family name. Answer once, or not at all.
ev_cl_press_pit.b2: The cameras are not interested in the answer. They want to see you answer.
ev_cl_press_pit.c.name_hale: Say Hale is the one to watch.
ev_cl_odds_board.b1: The odds on your match drop for no reason you can find.
ev_cl_odds_board.b2: Money moved before anyone had seen you play.
ev_cl_referee_tell.b1: Piers Dunne touches his whistle before a bad call. Count the times.
ev_cl_referee_tell.b2: It is the same hand. It is always the same hand.
ev_cl_referee_tell.c.record_it: Write the times in a notebook.
ev_cl_locker_talk.b1: Hale and you share a bench. He shares a worry.
ev_cl_locker_talk.b2: He is not asking for advice. He is checking whether you would give it.
ev_cl_locker_talk.c.share_back: Share a worry of your own.
ev_cl_empty_wall.b1: A League lobby has a bare spot where one name was. Selene tells the story, up to a point.
ev_cl_empty_wall.b2: She stops at the same sentence she always stops at.
ev_cl_ashdown_letter.b1: Ashdown writes to you in a careful hand: congratulations and a warning.
ev_cl_ashdown_letter.b2: The warning is the part he wanted you to read twice.
ev_cl_last_clean_match.b1: Selene asks for a fair spar with no stakes. It is the best battle of the run.
ev_cl_last_clean_match.b2: Neither of you keeps score. Both of you know.
ev_cl_last_clean_match.c.spar: Spar for the joy of it.
ev_cl_sealed_file.b1: A sealed file in the League archive has Gideon's name on one side and Selene's on the other.
ev_cl_sealed_file.b2: The seal has been opened and closed before.
ev_cl_the_choice.b1: The final is tonight. You can win clean, expose the Circle, forfeit on principle, or offer Hale the title.
ev_cl_the_choice.b2: The wall in the lobby is waiting for a name.
end.end_cl_clean_title.name: The Clean Title
end.end_cl_clean_title.scene: The lobby wall gets a new name, and an old one.
end.end_cl_circle_exposed.name: The Circle Exposed
end.end_cl_circle_exposed.scene: The Tournament is voided; you are thanked.
end.end_cl_joint_champions.name: Joint Champions
end.end_cl_principled_forfeit.name: The Principled Forfeit
end.end_cl_principled_forfeit.scene: An empty podium, a long applause.
end.end_cl_wall_unchanged.name: The Wall Unchanged
end.end_cl_wall_unchanged.scene: The lobby is as it was; you walk out.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.reveal: The fix is meant to put Ashdown's name back on the wall.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.motive: Ashdown believes the League lost its nerve.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.consequence: Clean title, exposure, forfeit, or a shared title.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.clue.clue_odds: The odds drift before the matches are played.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.clue.clue_whistl: The referee touches his whistle before bad calls.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.clue.clue_pin: The cracked laurel pin turns up on a referee.
tw.tw_reinstate_ashdown.clue.clue_locker: A fixed card is found in a locker.
tw.tw_selene_knew.reveal: Selene refused the same offer years ago and never reported it.
tw.tw_selene_knew.motive: She feared the League would break.
tw.tw_selene_knew.consequence: Trust with Selene reshapes the ending.
tw.tw_selene_knew.clue.clue_selene_silen: Selene falls silent at the empty wall.
tw.tw_selene_knew.clue.clue_letter_fragm: A fragment of a letter in her hand.
tw.tw_selene_knew.clue.clue_sealed_file: A sealed file with her name on it.
th.th_champions_legacy.journal.name: The Trophy Shelf
th.th_champions_legacy.journal.t1: {player} entered the {event} as a hopeful. {rival} counted the people in the stands.
th.th_champions_legacy.journal.t2: The referee touched the whistle again today.
th.th_champions_legacy.journal.t3: The empty wall in the lobby has fewer names than it should.
th.th_marauder_conspiracy.name: The Mythic Equation
ev_me_cage_cave.b1: A cave with torn wire and an empty cage. Something was held here, and moved in a hurry.
ev_me_cage_cave.b2: The cage door was opened from the outside.
ev_me_mover_coats.b1: A grunt squad poses as movers. Their uniforms are carefully hidden under coats.
ev_me_mover_coats.b2: The crates they carry are too light for what they claim is inside.
ev_me_stolen_case.b1: A display case at the Exhibition has been emptied. The lock was opened with a key.
ev_me_stolen_case.b2: The first proof that the Marauders are already inside.
ev_me_banquet.b1: At the Exhibition banquet, Cass Verrin approaches with a warm smile and a glass of water.
ev_me_banquet.b2: She remembers your name before you give it.
ev_me_empty_vault.b1: Equinar is reported missing from the observatory vault. The vault is empty and spotless.
ev_me_empty_vault.b2: Legend rung 2: a sighting, and an absence.
ev_me_quill_sign_off.b1: Chalk scientists run an experiment in a back hall. A form on the table bears the initials L.Q.
ev_me_quill_sign_off.b2: The initials belong to a woman Vance has not mentioned in years.
ev_me_coded_sheet.b1: A coded sheet and a tracker turn up in the Rival's abandoned room.
ev_me_coded_sheet.b2: The code is simple. The person who wrote it was not trying to hide it from the Rival.
ev_me_rival_secret.b1: Your Rival stands inside the Marauders' orbit and says so, out loud, for the first time.
ev_me_rival_secret.b2: The confession costs them more than a battle would.
ev_me_rival_secret.c.help_from_inside: Ask them to help from the inside.
ev_me_consent.b1: Equinar, through the Engine, asks without words whether you will let it choose.
ev_me_consent.b2: It waits. It has waited longer than the Exhibition has existed.
ev_me_the_choice.b1: The Engine hums. Destroy it, stabilize it, trust the Legend, rescue the captives first, or face Ashgrove.
ev_me_the_choice.b2: Each answer shapes the next two Stops and the ending.
end.end_me_silent_hinge.name: Silent Hinge
end.end_me_silent_hinge.scene: An ambiguous, quiet moment between a person and a Legend.
end.end_me_equinar_home.name: Equinar Home
end.end_me_equinar_home.scene: Equinar rises from the observatory and returns to the stones.
end.end_me_architect_walks.name: The Architect Walks
end.end_me_architect_walks.scene: A single envelope under Vance's door.
end.end_me_quorum_splits.name: The Quorum Splits
end.end_me_quorum_splits.scene: The team's symbol repainted on a new wall.
end.end_me_hollow_victory.name: A Hollow Victory
end.end_me_hollow_victory.scene: You stand at an empty arena while the crowd cheers elsewhere.
end.end_me_ascension_denied.name: Ascension Denied
end.end_me_ascension_denied.scene: An empty observatory and a lit sky.
end.end_me_long_wait.name: The Long Wait
end.end_me_long_wait.scene: Vance's cabinet stays closed; an unfinished Chronicle note.
tw.tw_rival_secret.reveal: The Rival is inside the Marauders' orbit.
tw.tw_rival_secret.motive: Fear, family, or belief, depending on the Rival.
tw.tw_rival_secret.clue.clue_tracker: A coded sheet or a tracker.
tw.tw_vance_knew.reveal: Vance wrote to the Marauders in their first year.
tw.tw_vance_knew.motive: She thought it was a research society.
tw.tw_vance_knew.clue.clue_photo: An old photograph of four colleagues.
tw.tw_vance_knew.clue.clue_vance_call: Vance's call hints at an invitation she already knew about.
th.th_marauder_conspiracy.journal.name: The Equation Notebook
th.th_marauder_conspiracy.journal.t1: Another {pokemon} has gone missing near {town}. {character} says it is a coincidence.
th.th_marauder_conspiracy.journal.t2: {rival} has stopped answering. The tracker still pings.
th.th_marauder_conspiracy.journal.t3: On {stage}, the Engine hummed once and went quiet.
